newDonation.title: Identify product
newDonation.subtitle: Take a photo of the pack. It identifies the product inside a reception: stock only goes up when you validate.
newDonation.subtitleRecepcion: This photo is attached to the open reception. Confirming identifies the product; it does not add stock yet.
newDonation.cameraLabel: Take a photo of the donated product
newDonation.compressInputTooLarge: The photo is over 10 MB. Take another one closer or with less zoom.
newDonation.compressOutputTooLarge: The photo is still too large after optimization. Try better lighting or move closer.
newDonation.heicConvertFailed: Could not convert the HEIC photo. Save it as JPEG and try again.
newDonation.noPermission: You do not have permission to identify products in a reception.
newDonation.eanOptionalHint: If the photo is not read automatically, type the EAN so we hit the catalogue / Open Food Facts instead of the AI.

via.ean: Resolved from the barcode (catalogue or Open Food Facts).
via.vision: The vision model read the product photo. Check name and quantity.
via.manual: Could not identify it. Fill in the details by hand.

newDonation.mergeNew: Not listed: add it to the catalogue

result.failedHint: Go back to the reception and try again.
result.needsConfirmHint: The photo identifies the product. Inventory is not updated until the reception is validated.
result.unidentifiedHint: The product was not recognised with enough confidence. It stays pending review so someone can confirm it by hand.

newDonation.confirmInvalid: Enter a name and a quantity greater than zero.
newDonation.needAcopio: Choose a collection centre before confirming.
newDonation.unitLabel: Which unit does this product go in?
newDonation.unitHint: Codes (PAL-…, CAJ-…) are generated by the system. If it is not in a container, choose loose.
newDonation.needUnit: Choose the pallet, the box or loose before confirming.
newDonation.expiryHint: Food and medicine need an expiry date to post to inventory when you validate.
newDonation.needExpiry: Enter the expiry date: without it, this line goes to quarantine on validate and does not add stock.

receptions.title: Receptions
receptions.subtitle: A truck, a walk-in donation or a transfer. Stock goes up when you validate, not when you take the photo.
receptions.newSubtitle: Record where it arrived and how it came. Then identify products and, if needed, generate pallets.
receptions.noPermission: You do not have permission to view receptions.
receptions.noPermissionWrite: You do not have permission to open receptions.
receptions.empty: No receptions yet. Open the first one.
receptions.unitsHint: If it arrived on pallets or in boxes, generate the units now. If it is loose, leave 0.
receptions.noUnits: Loose goods: no numbered pallets or boxes.
receptions.noLines: No products yet. Identify with a photo or add a line by hand.
receptions.validatedHint: Approved quantities are now in this centre’s inventory, on the receiving dock. Quarantine and rejected amounts are not stocked.
receptions.validatedPutawayHint: Validating is not locating: you still assign a destination and confirm the location code.
receptions.quarantineAfter: Some quantity is in quarantine (often because expiry is missing). That does not become available stock.
receptions.expiryMissing: Expiry is missing: on validate this quantity goes to quarantine, not inventory.
receptions.validateWarning: Some food or medicine lines have no expiry. On validate that quantity will not add stock: it stays in quarantine.

confirm.deleteAcopioDescription: It is permanently removed. Donations already registered there are left with no centre assigned.
confirm.removeMemberDescription: They lose access to the organisation. They can be reactivated later, but stop seeing the data immediately.
confirm.deleteRoleDescription: Anyone assigned to it is left with no permissions until another role is assigned.

acopios.title: Collection centres
acopios.subtitle: Warehouses are registered here: whether they receive donations, send them out, or both. They are not created when setting up the organisation.
acopios.empty: No collection centres yet. Create the first one with the form below.
acopios.name: Name

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Hours, contact person, what it accepts…

address.searchHint: Type at least 3 characters for suggestions (OpenStreetMap).
address.noResults: No suggestions. You can keep the address typed manually.
address.searchFailed: Could not search the address. Check your connection and try again.
address.mapHint: Drag the pin or tap the map to fine-tune. The address updates when you drop it.
address.geoDenied: Location permission denied. Allow it in the browser or drop the pin manually.
address.geoError: Could not get your location. Drop the pin on the map.

users.title: Users
users.inviteEmail: Email of the person to invite
users.subtitle: Organization members and the role they sign in with.
users.inviteHint: The person must already have an account with that email before they can be added.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.subtitle: The matrix is system-wide: a change applies to every organisation. New rows appear as modules are added (shipments).
roles.lockedTitle: The acopio administrator can't be modified
roles.lockedText: It's the only role that guarantees full access to the organisation: its permissions can't be removed and it can't be deactivated.

auth.name: Name
auth.usernameHint: 3 to 32 characters. Letters, numbers, dot and underscore.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.googleError: Could not sign in with Google
auth.googleCompleteSubtitle: Pick a username for SOS Chocó. Your email comes from Google.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: We sent a code to {{correo}}.
verifyEmail.checkLogs: Locally, if sending is off, the code and link appear in the api container logs.
verifyEmail.resent: If the mailbox exists and is unverified, you will get (or see in logs) a new code.
verifyEmail.needEmail: Enter the email to resend the code

onboarding.chooseTitle: How do you want to continue?
onboarding.subtitle: Your account is already created. You don't need an organization right now — you can set up your own or wait to be added to an existing one.
onboarding.createOrgDescription: If you coordinate a center, a soup kitchen or an institution. The collection point (receiving or sending donations) is added later, in its own section.
onboarding.waitInviteDescription: Someone from the organization adds you using the email {{correo}}. Until then you can sign in and check whether you've been added yet.
onboarding.roleNote: Whoever creates the organization becomes the collection Administrator. Whoever joins by invitation enters as a Volunteer.
onboarding.name: Name
onboarding.descriptionPlaceholder: What they do, where they operate, who they serve.
onboarding.createOrgLede: Just the basics (who they are and how to reach them). Collection centres —receiving or sending donations— are added in Acopios, once inside the panel.

waitingRoom.subtitle: You don't belong to any organisation yet. Once someone adds you with {{correo}}, reload this screen and you'll get into the panel.
waitingRoom.stillWaiting: No invitation yet. Nobody has added you with that email yet — try again in a bit.
waitingRoom.note: There's no magic link or automatic email: whoever invites you has to type this exact email address from Users.

hero.lede: Coordination of donations, collection centers and shipments. Create an account — the organization is optional until you set up your own or get invited.

acopios.title: Collection centers
acopios.body: WMS warehouses: location, contact and operation for each site.

usuarios.title: Users and roles
usuarios.body: Collaborators per organization, with role-based permissions.

recepciones.title: Receptions
recepciones.body: The truck or donation that arrives: identify products and stock goes up when you validate.

envios.title: Shipments
envios.body: Dispatch and tracking of deliveries to communities. Upcoming module.

dashboard.switchOrg: {{nombre}} ({{correo}}) can switch organisation when they belong to more than one.
dashboard.usersHint: Add already-registered people and assign roles.
dashboard.rolesHint: Editable matrix: roles, permissions and new entries.
dashboard.acopiosHint: Warehouses to receive or send donations.
dashboard.locationsHint: Zones, aisles and positions in each centre. Set them up before putting stock away.
dashboard.inventoryHint: Stock per collection centre: product, batch and expiry.
dashboard.receptionsHint: Open the arrival event, identify products and validate the inbound.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Stock for the selected centre. Validated goods land on the dock; putaway is a separate step.
inventory.pendingPutawayHint: {{count}} items on the dock. Validating does not locate them: you still confirm the destination.
inventory.noResultsHint: Try another term or clear a filter.
inventory.emptyGateTitle: Inventory lives in each storage center
inventory.emptyGateText: Create a storage center first. Without at least one active, there is nowhere to record stock.
inventory.newSubtitle: Add an item to the selected storage center.
inventory.editSubtitle: Update details and quantities. The record is kept.
inventory.modalHint: Esc closes without saving. The product starts active.

locations.title: Locations
locations.subtitle: Set up the warehouse map: zones, aisles and positions. The dock receives validated stock; storage is confirmed at putaway.
locations.systemHint: The dock is a system location: you can change capacity and what it allows, not the code or function.
locations.deactivateBody: It is not deleted. It stops receiving inventory. If it has stock, move it first.
locations.name: Name
locations.empty: No locations yet. Validating creates the dock; add a storage zone so you can put stock away.
locations.muelleHint: The code MUELLE is reserved for the receiving dock.
locations.noPermission: You do not have permission to view locations.

putaway.title: Pending putaway
putaway.subtitle: Approved inventory still on the dock. The system suggests a destination; the operator confirms the real location code.
putaway.empty: No inventory pending putaway at this centre.
putaway.scanHint: Type or scan the label code. It must match the assigned destination so the system records the real location, not the suggestion.
putaway.noSuggestions: No compatible storage locations. Create a zone first.
putaway.splitHint: If one rack cannot take it all, the plan splits the quantity across destinations.

movimientos.title: Move inventory
movimientos.subtitle: Move stock that is already put away from one zone to another. The destination code must match the label so the real move is recorded.
movimientos.empty: No located stock to move. Dock stock leaves through Put away.
movimientos.noDestinations: No compatible destinations. Check zones and what they allow.
movimientos.confirmHint: Type or scan the label code. It must match the chosen destination.
movimientos.historyEmpty: No movements in this centre yet.
